the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: G is geometrically connected, so after reducing to an algebraically closed ground field with rational closed points one may argue on components; the irreducible component Z through the identity is a closed subgroup scheme because Z x_k Z is reduced and irreducible and multiplication factors through Z; if another component Z' existed, choose a quasi-compact open U containing Z and avoiding Z', and set W to the image of Z x_k U -> G; W is open, quasi-compact, and a specialization argument shows any irreducible component meeting W equals a translate Zg contained in W, so W is a proper open and closed subset, contradicting connectedness (source lines 1171-1227)
